runtime_execution_pipeline.description: 11-step canonical request execution chain with cross-cutting Health, Recovery, Verification, and Audit

steps.action: Resolve and authenticate request identity
Verify creator authority and operator permissions
Evaluate compiled policy rulebook against request intent
Scan for injection patterns, homoglyphs, and zero-width chars
Fail-closed permission gate: REJECT unless explicitly permitted
Verify required runtime dependencies are available and healthy
Select matching skill and initialize sandbox environment
Execute skill/tool in sandboxed context with resource limits
Verify execution result against expected derivation
Record execution outcome in cryptographic reward ledger
Persist complete execution record to episodic memory with audit trace

goal_planning_pipeline.description: Goal lifecycle: creation, priority ordering, decomposition, dependency resolution, execution, evaluation, and reward linkage with explicit authority chain
goal_planning_pipeline.authority_chain: Safety > Policy > Creator authority > System constraints > Task objective

steps.action: Create goal with creator authority signature and priority level
Assign priority: Safety > Policy > Creator > Constraints > Task
Decompose goal into ordered subtask list
Resolve inter-task dependencies and build execution DAG
Run MCTS/deliberative search to produce optimal task plan
Gate each plan step through policy before execution
Execute plan steps sequentially in sandboxed context
Evaluate outcome against goal success criteria
Credit milestone reward in hash-chained ledger on success
Update goal state: COMPLETED / FAILED / RETRYING with provenance

memory_lifecycle_pipeline.description: Full cognitive memory lifecycle: from working memory through episodic recording, semantic consolidation, procedural encoding, retrieval, and retention management

steps.action: Hold current-turn context in transient working memory
Encode completed turn as episodic record with timestamp, confidence, provenance, tenant_user, verification_status
Vector-index retrieval for semantic memory across all stored episodes
Encode successful skill patterns into procedural/skill memory
Merge repeated episodic patterns into consolidated semantic memory
Retrieve relevant memories via top-k vector similarity for current context
Apply retention policy: expire stale low-confidence episodes within quota bounds

self_evolution_loop_pipeline.description: AGI self-improvement loop: experience extraction, evaluation, failure analysis, knowledge/memory update, skill improvement, training candidate generation, benchmark, regression gate, promotion or reject
hard_safety_rules: No self-promotion without passing regression benchmark gate
No self-modification without creator authority verification
Candidate models isolated in staging dir until all benchmarks pass

steps.action: Extract structured experience from completed task episodes
Evaluate experience quality, reasoning depth, and outcome correctness
Root-cause failure analysis or success reinforcement extraction
Update episodic memory and knowledge base with verified lessons
Synthesize or refine skill in dynamic capability registry
Assess whether neural self-training is warranted by experience volume and quality
Train isolated candidate model with EWC loss protection in staging directory
Run full benchmark suite against candidate model — must exceed baseline on ALL benchmarks
Promote on pass (creator authority required) or rollback on any regression

skill_tool_execution_loop.description: Complete agent skill/tool execution loop: goal-driven selection, authorization, sandbox execution, observation, verification, experience storage, and future selection improvement

steps.action: Retrieve active goal and map to required skill or tool capability
Discover available skill/tool matching goal intent from CapabilityRegistry and SkillEngine catalog
Authorize: validate caller permissions, SPDX license, and creator authority for privileged skills
Initialize sandboxed execution context with resource and capability bounds
Execute skill/tool through category dispatcher (coding, android, data, research, multimedia, math, science)
Observe and verify execution result against expected outcome derivation
Store experience: execution inputs, outputs, latency, and outcome in episodic memory
Credit reward in hash-chained ledger based on verified skill execution outcome
Update skill selection weights: improve future capability selection based on this execution outcome

cross_cutting: AbilityEngine::improve_skill on repeated success to synthesize composite skills

neural_model_training_pipeline.description: End-to-end neural model lifecycle: dataset → quality filter → dedup → leakage check → split → tokenizer → training → checkpoint → candidate → evaluation → regression → safety gate → promotion → model registry → inference
neural_model_training_pipeline.production_model_rule: Production model and candidate model are STRICTLY separated. Candidate lives in staging dir until all benchmarks pass. No auto-promotion without creator authority + benchmark gate.

steps.action: Download and ingest datasets from curriculum plan into raw shards
Quality filter: remove low-quality, malformed, and toxic records
Semantic and exact deduplication across all shards using dynamic SHA registry
Leakage check: verify no test-set data appears in training shards
Split into canonical/weak/validation shards with dynamic partition ratios
Tokenize all shards using native TARA tokenizer from dynamic vocab config
Train candidate model with EWC loss protection in isolated staging directory
Save checkpoint with SafeTensors format and SHA-256 dynamic manifest entry
Register candidate in staging — NOT promoted to production
Evaluate candidate model across full benchmark suite
Regression check: candidate MUST exceed baseline on ALL benchmarks — one failure = reject
Safety gate: all required runtimes must pass before promotion is eligible
Promote candidate to production (requires creator authority signature)
Register promotion event in versions_manifest.json with dynamic SHA
Hot-reload production weights into active inference engine

manual_training_pipeline.description: Developer-controlled manual training workspace: reads manual_training/config/, executes NativeSelfTrainer with custom hyperparameters, stages isolated checkpoints to manual_training/checkpoints/ (neural & world_model), writes run metrics to manual_training/runs/ and logs to manual_training/logs/, executes SkillsEvaluator on request, and requires explicit manual promotion gate before writing to production.
manual_training_pipeline.isolation_rule: Manual training operates in an isolated operational workspace. Production weights (production/neural/ or storage/models/tara/) are never touched without explicit --promote flag and passing evaluation benchmark.

steps.action: Load hyperparameter configuration (batch size, learning rate, max steps, dataset path, warmup steps, grad clip norm)
Execute training loop with AdamW optimizer, EWC penalty, and backpropagation
Save intermediate neural checkpoint to manual_training/checkpoints/neural/model.safetensors
Save candidate world model snapshot to manual_training/checkpoints/world_model/world_model_state.json
Persist training telemetry run JSON and append loss log
Execute core competencies benchmark suite and record manual_eval_report.json
Verify benchmark pass rate >= 60%, compute dynamic SHA-256, and promote candidate to production (production/neural/ and production/world_model/)

world_model_training_and_update_pipeline.description: World model epistemic updating and snapshot lifecycle: new evidence -> validation -> ontological & causal update -> candidate snapshot staging -> consistency evaluation -> verified promotion.
world_model_training_and_update_pipeline.neural_distinction: Neural models update weights via loss gradients and backpropagation; World models update state via evidence validation, causal graph consistency, and verifiable facts without unconstrained weight drift.

steps.action: Acquire new factual or environmental evidence during cognitive turns or autonomous research
Validate consistency against ground-truth knowledge graph and causal constraints
Update in-memory entity attributes and world state graph
Stage candidate world state snapshot to isolated directory (autonomous_training/world_model/candidates/ or manual_training/checkpoints/world_model/)
Validate candidate snapshot consistency before promotion
Promote candidate snapshot to official production (production/world_model/world_model_state.json and storage/persistence/world_model_state.json)

security_governance_pipeline.description: Cross-cutting security and governance layer applied at every request boundary and every model/code evolution event
security_governance_pipeline.cross_cutting_scope: ALL requests, ALL tool invocations, ALL model promotions, ALL source code evolutions

steps.action: Resolve and authenticate request identity via token or session
Verify Creator authority for privileged operations
Scan payload for embedded credentials, injection tokens, and prompt leaks
Inspect for homoglyphs, bidirectional overrides, zero-width chars, and prompt injection
Policy gate: fail-closed authorization check before every action
Verify no protected source symbols have been unauthorized-modified
Verify all critical runtime dependencies are present and unmodified
Verify HMAC seal over SafeTensors model weights and manifest
Validate release manifest signature and component inventory before promotion
Append tamper-evident audit entry to encrypted ledger for every gated action
Trigger durable lockdown on repeated authentication failures or tampering detection

robotics_command_safety.description: When TARA interfaces with hardware actuators, an additional hardware safety chain applies
chain: KinematicLimitsChecker::validate — ensure within joint and workspace bounds
DestructionGuard::check — reject any command that could cause self-damage or environmental harm
EmergencyStop::arm — keep hardware kill-switch armed during all actuator operations
SensorFeedback::verify — confirm actuator state matches intended command
